title: Video by earn.edits
description:
🎬 Your footage ends. Your scene doesn’t have to.

Agentic Extend in InVideo Editor lets you ask the agent to generate the missing part right on your timeline. Add it at the beginning, at the end, or in a gap in the middle, up to 30 seconds ⚡

🎭 It reads the scene’s visual and audio context and continues the characters, action, voice, and sound. Audio lands on separate editable layers, and extensions are generated in HDR with 16-bit output 🔥

🗣️ Adobe Premiere’s Generative Extend covers video and ambient audio, but not dialogue or music. InVideo extends the whole scene.

👀 Watch where my clip ended and where the AI took over.

Try it in InVideo Editor 🔗
